Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 4a and 4b) clearly show hyperdense, branching material within the pulmonary arteries consistent with acrylic cement emboli. This iatrogenic embolization obstructs lower lobe vessels, leading to compensatory redistribution of blood flow to the upper and ventral lung areas, which appears as pronounced vessels on the chest X-ray.
